testcase.name: retired-observe

failure.message: rule could not run: "observe" is no longer a rule modifier. It meant "report this and never gate", and a rule that keeps its bands without it does gate — so leaving it in place would silently invert what the rule was written to do. Delete the bands to stop the rule judging, or delete "observe" to let it judge.

testcase.name: retired-onmissing

failure.message: rule could not run: "onMissing" is no longer a rule modifier. A target that matches nothing is now NOT_JUDGED / NO_MATCH and never fails the run on its own, because a plan running a subset is legitimate — so a rule relying on "onMissing": "fail" would pass where it used to fail. Delete the key; if a missing sampler must stop the build, assert on it in the pipeline.
